regime.label: Short-gamma corridor intact to the 1110 flip with spot 1.7 points through the 1080 call wall, but the Vol2Vol tape fails to confirm: 1,614 lots, flat IV and put-led flow
evidence: 1110 is the gamma flip and cumulative net dealer gamma is -2,163 at the 1081.7 anchor, negative from 1000 upward, so the whole 1081.7-1110 corridor is short-gamma territory where dealers hedge with the move. Read the sign, not the size: total GEX is only +4,519.

1,081.7 closed 1.7 points above the 1080 call wall (2,273 OI) after two sessions beneath it, but the Vol2Vol filter fails on three of four legs: 1,614 total lots is the thinnest tape in seven sessions, ATM IV moved 0.12 points to 13.62%, and flow ran put-led 923 to 691 (P/C vol 1.34).

25-delta skew flipped to +0.88 (1040 put 14.09% vs 1120 call 13.20%) from -0.02 on 08-07 and -0.57 on 08-05: three sessions from call-rich to a downside-protection bid, the clearest positioning change in the window.
1100 is now the live near-money call wall at 2,035 OI (+66) on 199 lots, the busiest line in the chain, displacing 1080 which shed 9 contracts on 110 lots.

S50U26.today_summary: 1,081.7 settled +2.2 with the 1-sigma day at 9.28 points (0.86%), ATM IV at 13.62% and max pain 11.7 points below at 1070. Put volume led calls 923 to 691 for a 1.34 P/C volume ratio, the highest since 07-31, while total volume collapsed to 1,614 lots, the thinnest session in the seven-day window. The 25-delta skew flipped to +0.88 put-rich from -0.02 on Friday, and 1100 took over as the live call wall at 2,035 OI on 199 lots. Cumulative dealer gamma stays negative to 1110, so the corridor above spot is still an amplifier, not a brake.
what_changed: 25-delta skew flipped to +0.88 put-rich from -0.02 on 08-07 and -0.57 on 08-05, the first sustained protection bid in three sessions.
1100 call OI overtook 1080 as the live near-money wall, adding 66 contracts on 199 lots against 1080's -9 on 110 lots.
Spot reclaimed the 1080 call wall at 1,081.7 after two sessions beneath it (1,076.0 on 08-05, 1,079.5 on 08-07).
Volume dried to 1,614 lots from 4,507 on 08-05, so the OI build (+236 puts, +166 calls) arrived on the thinnest tape of the window.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Five sessions on from 08-01 the future has gone nowhere, 1,084.2 to 1,081.7 (-2.5 points, -0.23%), while ATM IV compressed from 14.05% to 13.62% and the 1-sigma day tightened to 9.28 points. Max pain drifted up 10 points to 1070 and the near-money put wall migrated from 1040 to 1050, both following price rather than leading it. No GEX sign flip occurred in the window: cumulative gamma has been negative below the flip throughout and the flip itself has oscillated only between 1110 and 1120 across all seven sessions, so the short-gamma corridor is a standing feature, not a new signal. Total GEX built from the 07-31 low of +1,393 to +4,519, a 3.2x increase that is entirely above 1100 (+1,505 there, while GEX at and below 1090 went marginally more negative, -1,790 to -1,818) on +1,683 call contracts across 1100-1150 -- the long-gamma shelf is thickening above the flip, not around spot. The genuine change is the skew, from -0.73 on 07-28 to +0.88 today, and the tape behind it: 6,641 lots on 07-31 against 1,614 today.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1080 / 1110
strategies.rationale: The full 30-point width sits inside the 1081.7-1110 corridor where cumulative gamma is negative and dealers hedge with the move (heatmap-zones: short gamma amplifies), and it terminates exactly at the flip where dampening begins; buying at 13.62% ATM IV near the low end of the seven-session range (13.29-15.01%) is the cheap-vol side of the trade, though the 1080 leg carries a 14.60% wall premium against 13.24% sold at 1110.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 13.00 points, the net debit at mid (22.95 - 9.95); max gain = 17.00 points; breakeven 1093.0, which is +1.22 sigma of a single session.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close back below 1080, the call wall it just reclaimed, or a break above 1100 that stalls on volume below the 199 lots traded there today.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1070 / 1040
strategies.rationale: Expresses today's skew rotation to +0.88 put-rich and the put-led 1.34 P/C volume as defined-risk insurance rather than a directional call, and it sits directly over the 1040-1070 negative-GEX pocket (-189 at 1070, -60 at 1060, -570 at 1050, -598 at 1040) where a break lower is amplified; the vertical skew pays you to structure it this way, buying the 1070 put at 12.89% IV and selling the 1040 put at 14.09%.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 8.35 points, the net debit at mid (16.55 - 8.20); max gain = 21.65 points; breakeven 1061.65.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close above 1100 with call OI still building there voids the protection premise; the structure also bleeds if the future simply holds 1080-1090, since 50 DTE gives the pocket time to be avoided entirely.

S50U26.prediction: 1,070-1,100 brackets the base case: max pain 1070 anchors the low and the 1100 call wall (2,035 OI on 199 lots) caps the high, a 30-point band that a 9.28-point 1-sigma day needs roughly 3.2 sessions to traverse. A daily close above 1100 opens the short-gamma corridor to the 1110 flip and is the bullish trigger; a close below 1070 drops price into the 1040-1070 negative-GEX pocket where hedging sells into weakness, with 1050 (1,257 put OI) the first shelf. Neither break is confirmed on a 1,614-lot tape with IV flat at 13.62% -- the Vol2Vol filter argues for volume and an IV move before either level is trusted.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only, not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain 1070 and the 1110 gamma flip as tendencies, not guarantees. The 910 put wall's 10,711 OI is 36% of all put open interest but fails the Vol2Vol test outright (64 lots, 15.9% out of the money) and must not be read as live support; the naive max-pain minimum is dragged to the 1030 window boundary by that block, which is why the scraper's 1070 is the figure carried here. Defined risk is not risk-free: each debit structure above can lose the full premium paid, and macro or news flow can override the option structure entirely. Data reflects the 10 Aug session, scraped 10 Aug 23:55 (+07:00).
